title: Welcome to Jasper's Sec
summary: How to publish your first report. Delete this entry once you have your own.
body:
## Publishing a report

Reports live in `data/reports.json`. Add an object with `id`, `title`, `date`, `type`, `tags`, `summary` and `body`.

The body is Markdown: headings, **bold**, `inline code`, lists, links and fenced code blocks.

- Use `tools/new_report.py "Title"` to add a skeleton from the terminal.
- Or open `admin.html`, edit the JSON in the browser and download it.
